import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.continuity import ContinuityPrincipal, ContinuityStore
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    db=Path(raw)/'continuity.sqlite3'; store=ContinuityStore(db)
    writer=ContinuityPrincipal('writer','tenant-a',('writer',),('delivery-review@1',)); promoter=ContinuityPrincipal('reviewer','tenant-a',('promoter',),('delivery-review@1',)); reader=ContinuityPrincipal('reader','tenant-a',('reader',),('delivery-review@1',))
    payload={'schema':'factory.continuity.record.v1','tenant_id':'tenant-a','record_type':'decision','memory_ref':'memory://adr-42','purpose':{'id':'delivery-review','version':'1'},'scope':{'repository_ref':'repo:sha256:smoke'},'evidence_refs':['receipt:proof-42'],'expires_at':(datetime.now(timezone.utc)+timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()}
    store.record(writer,payload,idempotency_key='smoke',record_id='smoke-record')
    assert not store.recall(reader,'tenant-a',purpose_ref='delivery-review@1',scope_ref='repo:sha256:smoke')['records']
    store.promote(promoter,'tenant-a','smoke-record',reason='independently reviewed')
    result=store.recall(reader,'tenant-a',purpose_ref='delivery-review@1',scope_ref='repo:sha256:smoke')
    assert result['marker']=='CONTINUITY_RECALL_SCOPE_AND_PURPOSE_EXACT' and len(result['records'])==1
print('FACTORY_CONTINUITY_SMOKE_PASS')
